description: Permissions for the Groovium widget window. Deliberately narrow: only what the custom titlebar and the collapse need. The file picker is not here on purpose — it runs in Rust (src/library.rs), so the webview has no dialog permission at all. set-size and set-resizable are for compact mode, which shrinks the window to its controls; without them the resize is denied and the bar is drawn inside a full-height window. The updater checks and downloads; restart is the only thing `process` is here for, since an installer that has replaced the running binary needs the app started again.
